lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, typically containing 4-5 spots per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance spots to form a regular grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-upper flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and sharp shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Small, elongated high-luminance objects are attached to the ventral surface near the base of the pectoral fin.
